{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled P2P and modifies socket polling in src/net.cpp to avoid busy loops in the network event loop.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.68,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Prevents CPU-exhausting busy loops in the network event loop caused by unhandled TCP urgent data in select(). As noted in commit 1c27aa5bef, select() continuously reports TCP urgent indications when recv() has no data to read, causing a busy loop unless exceptional conditions disconnect the peer or are ignored."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies socket exception handling and disconnection logic in src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents socket exception loops on HTTP connections by disconnecting established connections on Windows and ignoring unneeded exception sets elsewhere. This hardens the embedded HTTP server against resource exhaustion from exceptional socket conditions."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test framework changes in test_framework/netutil.py support specific functional tests for socket errors rather than general test infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The additions to test_framework specifically serve tests verifying P2P and HTTP socket behavior under raw TCP conditions, which belong to the tested areas rather than general test harness infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Minor additions to src/util/sock.cpp and src/util/sock.h are driven entirely by net.cpp and httpserver.cpp requirements.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The minimal 8-line modification to the Sock wrapper class is ancillary to the networking event loop changes and does not constitute a substantive utility improvement."
    }
